models.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
models.notes: Encoder-decoder MoE: 552B backbone + ~196B Engram memory, 8B active in prefill and 16B in decode, image input. No llama.cpp/GGUF/MLX runtime as of Sep 2026. q4 is an estimate; 510GB is the native FP4/FP8 checkpoint.

models.name: MiMo V2.6 Flash 309B-A15B
models.notes: Newest open MoE (Sep 21 2026). Native MXFP4 weights are 173GB. Community GGUFs: MXFP4 167GB, Q2_K 126GB, mixed quant ~93GB for 128GB machines. The Pro sibling is 1.02T-A42B (566GB).

models.name: GLM-5.3
models.license: GLM-5.3 License (custom; security review above $10B MaaS revenue)
models.notes: Top open coding/agentic model. Same base as the MIT-licensed GLM-5.2. GGUF: 1-bit 228GB, 2-bit 254GB. Ollama cloud only.

models.name: GLM-5.3-Flash 320B-A18B
models.notes: Text+image MoE. Fits 128GB machines at 2-3 bit (UD-Q2_K_XL 109GB, 1-bit 93GB). New architecture needs Unsloth's glm5next llama.cpp branch. Ollama cloud only.

models.name: Qwen3.8 Flash-Next 125B-A6B
models.notes: 125B MoE plus a 51B n-gram embedding table that can stay on SSD via mmap: Q4_K_M uses ~55GB of RAM plus ~38GB on disk. The Ollama q4 tag is 120GB. Preview of the Qwen4 architecture; vision.

models.name: Granite 4.2 30B
models.notes: Dense enterprise model with a reasoning toggle, RAG, tool use and JSON output. 128K native, 512K extended.

models.name: Ornith-1.5 35B-A3B
models.notes: Self-improving RL coding/agent post-train on a Qwen3.5-family 35B-A3B base. Trending on Ollama. Also ships 9B and 397B (242GB q4).

models.name: Qwen3.8 27B
models.notes: Best current single-GPU (24GB) model. Dense hybrid DeltaNet/attention, thinking mode, native vision, MTP. 2.8M Ollama pulls in 6 weeks.

models.name: Qwen3.8-Max 2.4T-A95B
models.notes: Top of the open-weight leaderboards. FP8 release is 2.5TB. Rack scale: even the 1-bit GGUFs are 397-508GB.

models.name: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B
models.notes: Hybrid Mamba-2/MoE for always-on agents. The small KV cache keeps long context cheap, and decode is very fast.

models.name: Muse Glimmer 30B
models.notes: Meta's only open model since Llama 4 (there is no Llama 5). Dense agentic model with image input. Ships a DFlash drafter: ~75 tok/s, ~233 with the drafter on an RTX 5090.

models.name: Kimi K3
models.notes: Largest open-weight model. Native MXFP4 (QAT) at ~1.4-1.56TB. GGUF: 1-bit 594GB, 2-bit 861GB. Native vision.

models.name: Laguna S 2.1 118B-A8B
models.notes: Agentic-coding MoE, mostly sliding-window attention. Poolside recommends 128GB unified memory (13-18 tok/s). Min is estimated from a ~3-bit quant.

models.name: Hunyuan Hy3 295B-A21B
models.notes: Official 1-bit GGUF (91.8GB) runs on a 128GB Strix Halo at ~17 tok/s, ~24 with MTP. In mainline llama.cpp since Jul 14 2026.

models.name: Laguna XS 2.1 33B-A3B
models.notes: Local agentic-coding MoE sized for 32GB machines, with reasoning and tool calling.

models.name: North Mini Code 1.0 30B-A3B
models.notes: Cohere's first coding model, for agentic SWE and terminal tasks. 64K max output.

models.name: Gemma 4 12B
models.notes: Encoder-free unified multimodal laptop model (image, audio and video in). QAT build is 7.2GB.

models.name: MiniMax M3
models.notes: Natively multimodal agentic/coding MoE. The GGUF is text-only with dense attention (no MSA), so long context is costly locally. Ollama cloud only.

models.name: Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B-A55B
models.notes: Hybrid Mamba/LatentMoE flagship with an NVFP4 build. 2-bit GGUF is 170GB. Ollama cloud only.

models.name: Command A+ 218B-A25B
models.notes: Enterprise RAG/agent MoE with native citations and vision. Official W4A4/FP8 builds for vLLM. GGUF/llama.cpp support unconfirmed; sizes are formula estimates.

models.name: Mistral Medium 3.5 128B
models.notes: Dense merged instruct/reasoning/coding flagship that replaces Magistral and Devstral 2; image input. Slow except on big GPUs because all 128B are active.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro 1.6T-A49B
models.notes: Native FP4 experts with FP8 elsewhere (~860GB). Quants below 4 bits degrade sharply, so ~900GB is the practical floor. 0813 update. Ollama cloud only.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash 284B-A13B
models.notes: Best open model for a single 128GB machine: 2-bit is ~102GB, ~39 tok/s on an M5 Max. Native FP4/FP8, so Q8 (162GB) is lossless. 0731 update; in llama.cpp since late June 2026.

models.name: Qwen3.6 27B
models.notes: Very popular dense agentic-coding model for 24GB GPUs, with vision, thinking preservation and MTP.

models.name: Kimi K2.6
models.notes: Native INT4 (QAT) at ~594GB, so Q8 is effectively lossless. 2-bit GGUF is 340GB. Vision. Ollama cloud only.

models.name: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B
models.notes: Most-pulled Ollama model of 2026 (6.9M). Fast 3B-active MoE that runs well with experts offloaded to system RAM. Vision.

models.name: MiniMax M2.7
models.notes: Popular agentic/coding MoE for 128GB+ machines (UD-Q2_K_XL 75GB, 1-bit 61GB). Ollama cloud only.

models.name: Gemma 4 31B

models.name: Gemma 4 26B-A4B
models.notes: MoE with near-31B quality at ~4B-active speed. QAT build is 16GB.

models.name: Mistral Small 4 119B-A6.5B
models.notes: MoE that unifies Instruct, reasoning (Magistral) and Devstral; image input. Fits 96-128GB machines at Q4.

models.name: Nemotron 3 Super 120B-A12B

models.name: Qwen3.5 397B-A17B

models.name: Qwen3-Coder-Next 80B-A3B
models.notes: Agentic coding MoE on the hybrid DeltaNet Qwen3-Next architecture; very fast for its size. 2.1M Ollama pulls.

models.name: GLM-4.7-Flash 30B-A3B

notes:
Researched 2026-09-29 against Hugging Face model cards, Ollama library tag pages, Unsloth GGUF pages and docs, and vendor blogs. Some HF cards could not be read directly (e.g. MiMo returned 401), so a few facts come from secondary news or guide sites; those entries are marked medium confidence. 54 entries, newest first.

HOW THE NUMBERS WERE CHOSEN
- Sizes are decimal GB. Where an ollama_tag is given, q4/q8/fp16 are that Ollama tag's download sizes, which include the vision projector for multimodal models. Otherwise they come from Unsloth GGUFs (UD-Q4_K_XL when no Q4_K_M exists). Otherwise they use the formula q4≈0.60×P, q8≈1.07×P, fp16≈2×P.
- Some models ship natively in 4-bit (gpt-oss MXFP4, Kimi K2.6 INT4, Kimi K3 MXFP4, DeepSeek V4 FP4 experts, MiMo V2.6 MXFP4). For these, q8 is about the same as q4 because Q8 GGUFs keep the experts in 4-bit. fp16 is the BF16 upcast estimate, which nobody actually runs.
- min_runtime_mem_gb is weights plus KV cache and overhead at ~4K context:
  - Models up to ~40B: Q4_K_M or native MXFP4 plus 1-3GB.
  - Dense 70-130B: Q3_K_M.
  - Big MoEs: the smallest widely used Unsloth dynamic quant (UD-Q2_K_XL; 1-bit for models over 1T).
  - DeepSeek V4 Pro: nothing below 4-bit, because its FP4-QAT experts degrade sharply under further quantization.
- A 2-bit fit counts as 'runs, degraded'. Treat hitting min_runtime as SLOW at best.

MoE HANDLING
- Memory depends on params_total_b; decode speed on params_active_b. A rough speed estimate is memory bandwidth ÷ (active params × bytes per param at the quant).
- llama.cpp (--n-cpu-moe) and Ollama can keep MoE experts in system RAM with attention on the GPU. For MoEs, check fit against RAM + VRAM combined, with speed limited by RAM bandwidth.
- Hybrid Mamba/DeltaNet models have much smaller KV caches: Nemotron 3/3.5, Qwen3.5/3.6/3.8, and Qwen3-Coder-Next.

FIELD CONVENTIONS
- Modality: 'text' means a general chat model. Most 2026 releases have a hybrid thinking mode and many accept images; this is stated in notes. They were kept as 'text' so a separate VLM catalog can own pure vision models. 'reasoning' means reasoning-first (gpt-oss, DeepSeek-R1). 'code' means coding-specialised.
- ollama_tag is empty ('') when Ollama only offers a :cloud tag. That applies to GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash, Kimi K2.6/K3, MiniMax M2.7/M3, DeepSeek V4 Pro/V4.1 Flash and Nemotron 3 Ultra. Ollama retired its deepseek-v4-flash listing on Aug 27 2026.
- in_browser: only gpt-oss-20b is known to run in the browser (transformers.js v4 WebGPU ONNX). WebLLM's only prebuilt model above 9B is Llama-3.1-70B q3f16 (~31GB VRAM), noted on the Llama 3.3 70B entry.

RUNTIME CAVEATS
- DeepSeek V4.1 Flash has no local runtime yet (no llama.cpp, GGUF or MLX); its q4 is an estimate.
- GLM-5.3-Flash needs Unsloth's glm5next llama.cpp branch.
- Command A+ has official W4A4/FP8 builds for vLLM, but GGUF support is unconfirmed; its sizes are formula estimates.
- The MiniMax M3 GGUF is text-only with dense attention.
- Qwen3.8 Flash-Next's 51B n-gram table can stay on SSD. Its q4 (93GB) is the full GGUF, and min_runtime counts only the ~55GB that must be in RAM.

CONTEXT
- Many models advertise 1M context. Local KV cache at long context adds a lot of memory; context_k is the native maximum. Qwen3 dense models are 32K native, 128K with YaRN.

LEFT OUT (superseded, niche, or cloud-only; add back if wanted)
- Qwen3.5-27B/35B-A3B (replaced by Qwen3.6/3.8).
- GLM-5.2 (MIT license, same 744-753B base as GLM-5.3), GLM-4.5/4.6/4.7 355B, GLM-4.5-Air.
- Kimi K2/K2.5/K2-Thinking, and Kimi K2.7 Code (Ollama is cloud-only; Unsloth GGUFs exist).
- MiniMax M2/M2.5, DeepSeek V3.x.
- Mistral Large 3 (675B), Magistral, Devstral 2 123B (Mistral Medium 3.5 replaces both), Command A 111B.
- Seed-OSS-36B (ByteDance's only open LLM, Aug 2025).
- ERNIE 4.5 300B-A47B and 21B-A3B (ERNIE 5.x has no open weights).
- Hunyuan Hy4-preview 770B-A49B (Aug 28 2026), MiMo V2.6 Pro 1.02T-A42B.
- Nemotron 3 Nano and Nano Omni 33B, Mixtral, OLMo 3.1 32B, Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B.
- Meta has released no Llama 5; its only 2026 open model is Muse Glimmer 30B. OpenAI has released nothing after gpt-oss.
